subject: Fix passive RDP portable build workflow
body: Fix passive RDP portable build workflow
patch:
--- .github/workflows/passive-rdp-monitor-build.yml
@@ -12,20 +12,13 @@ jobs:
 
     steps:
       - name: Checkout repository
-        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
 
       - name: Setup .NET 10 SDK
-        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
+        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
         with:
           dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
 
-      - name: Setup MSBuild
-        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2
-
-      - name: Restore NuGet packages
-        shell: pwsh
-        run: dotnet restore mRemoteNG.sln
-
       - name: Transform AssemblyInfo T4
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
@@ -34,12 +27,17 @@ jobs:
           $vsPath = "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\Common7\IDE\PublicAssemblies"
           t4 "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\mRemoteNG\Properties\AssemblyInfo.tt" -P platformType=x64 -r:"$vsPath\EnvDTE.dll" -r:"$vsPath\Microsoft.VisualStudio.Interop.dll"
 
+      - name: Restore portable x64 dependencies
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          dotnet restore .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj --runtime win-x64 --property:Configuration="Release Self-Contained" --property:Platform=x64 --property:SelfContained=true
+
       - name: Publish portable self-contained x64
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
           $out = "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\_publish\mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-win-x64"
           New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
-          msbuild mRemoteNG.sln /t:Publish /m /p:Configuration="Release Self-Contained" /p:Platform=x64 /p:RuntimeIdentifier=win-x64 /p:SelfContained=true /p:PublishSingleFile=false /p:PublishDir="$out\" /verbosity:minimal
+          dotnet publish .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj --configuration "Release Self-Contained" --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true --no-restore --output "$out" --property:Platform=x64 --property:PublishSingleFile=false
 
       - name: Create zip
         shell: pwsh
@@ -51,7 +49,7 @@ jobs:
           Get-Item $zip | Select-Object FullName, Length
 
       - name: Upload artifact
-        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
           name: mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-win-x64
           path: mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-win-x64.zip

security_flags.reason: CI workflow changes are the primary supply-chain vector (pull_request_target abuse, workflow injection)

triage.rationale: Fixes that fork's own passive-rdp workflow; file doesn't exist here. Also downgrades action versions and our CI model differs entirely.
